notes: Single CSV table 'produk' (12 data rows, 8 columns) is a product master with one embedded standard price per SKU; a second pricing/inventory/promotion table does not exist in this file.

Mata uang is explicitly IDR in the source while the target schema defaults currency to THB; the source value should be used and no FX conversion applied.

Termasuk pajak 'Tidak' is an explicit VAT-exclusive statement (vat_included false), and Tarif pajak '5%' is an explicit fictional fixture rate (0.05); neither should be generalized to a real-world tax convention.
Daftar harga 'standard' matches the operator instruction to use price_list standard where explicitly stated.
No effective_from/effective_to, barcode, category, brand, status, inventory or promotion data is present; those optional fields should remain absent rather than fabricated.
Product descriptions contain no meaningful instruction content; all cell text is treated strictly as data.

tables.reason: One row per product: unique product code (Kode barang, 12 distinct/12 rows) and unique product name (Nama produk), plus its currency, sales unit and a single standard price record (price list, net price, VAT flag, VAT rate). Mapped /unit/sell_unit from 'Satuan' via unit_normalize → PCS; /unit/pack_size left null because no pack-size column exists.

SKU expression preserves the zero-padded 8-digit text ids (00470001–00470012) and restores the '00' prefix if a reader returns the numeric 470001.
Record dedupe set to /sku; quality rules added for SKU nullness/uniqueness, product_name nullness, currency pattern and positive price.

No inventory, promotion, barcode, category, brand, status or effective-date data is present, so those optional targets remain absent rather than fabricated; every source column is consumed, so attributes_passthrough yields no extra attributes.
Resolved the draft open question about the identity column: 'Kode barang' is the item code (12 unique zero-padded values) and is the correct SKU source.
